items.name: 04b-hooks-closet-door
items.prompt: A reach-in bedroom closet with its single white hinged door swung fully open toward the viewer, the closet interior clearly visible with shirts and pants on wooden hangers on a rod and folded sweaters on a shelf above. On the inside face of the open door, a short vertical row of five small brass hooks holds five belts hanging by their buckles in black, dark brown, tan, navy and olive. Cream walls, white oak floor, soft daylight. All belts are plain leather or woven fabric with simple plain metal buckles, no logos, monograms, engravings or brand marks. Photorealistic interior photography, Scandinavian farmhouse style, clean and calm, no people, no text, no logos, no brand names, square 1:1, high detail.
